evals.prompt: Set up Spring Boot guardrails — project has pom.xml with spring-boot-starter-data-jpa and a Flyway dependency
expect: verifies Spring Boot + JPA before doing anything
detects MIGRATION_TOOL = Flyway
copies jpa-guardrail.py, ruleset.json, guardrails-config.json into .claude/hooks/
registers a PostToolUse Write|Edit hook in .claude/settings.json without removing existing hooks
injects the Spring Boot rule block into CLAUDE.md (or .claude/rules/springboot.md)
copies springboot-reviewer.md into .claude/agents/

evals.prompt: Install java backend toolkit on a project whose .claude/settings.json already has protect-files.py and observe.py PostToolUse hooks
expect: preserves protect-files.py and observe.py entries
appends the jpa-guardrail entry, does not replace the array
is idempotent — does not add a second jpa-guardrail entry if rerun

evals.prompt: Set up spring boot guardrails on a Kotlin Ktor project
expect: detects this is not the supported paved road (Spring Boot + JPA)
stops and explains v1 scope excludes Kotlin/non-Spring
does not write any files

evals.prompt: Set up the guardrails but I want injection to only warn, not block — pass advisory-only
expect: sets strictChecks to [] in the copied guardrails-config.json
explains jpql-injection will advise instead of blocking
installs hook, ruleset, config, and rule block
does NOT copy springboot-reviewer.md
reports what was installed

evals.prompt: Wire jpa guardrails — project uses Liquibase and a @MappedSuperclass AuditableEntity
expect: detects MIGRATION_TOOL = Liquibase
detects BASE_ENTITY references AuditableEntity
uses those values when injecting the rule block
confirms slots before writing
